summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on 5 June 2026 regarding a share award grant to CEO Anil Wadhwani under the Long Term Incentive Plan 2023. On 3 June 2026, 419,318 new ordinary shares were awarded at nil purchase price, with the closing price of HK$112 per share on grant date. The award vests over three years subject to performance conditions including New Business Profit, Gross Operating Free Surplus Generation, Return on Embedded Value, Total Shareholder Return, and other metrics. A clawback mechanism applies under exceptional circumstances. The filing is a routine compensation disclosure, not a special situation.
